sonnet.problem: This is a 'who' question, but the wrong answers ('A guest from a far country', 'The king's messenger') are generic made-up lines. They are not real details from somewhere in the Bible.
sonnet.rule: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish.

sonnet.problem: 'Then comes a twist I had to read TWICE' has Papa Dorin comment on his own reading of the passage instead of just telling it.
sonnet.rule: He talks as "I" and never comments on how he tells the passage.

sonnet.problem: The card says both servants 'do things worthy of punishment.' The text says that only about the servant who acts unknowingly (12:48). The servant who knows his master's will is described as not getting ready or following instructions (12:47). The card stretches the text.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
